$schema_note: Lane B deliverable. Built by corpus/B-liber-primus/build_pages.py. Do not hand-edit.

numbering.lp2_pages: 0-57 (onion7 / relikd file numbers). This is the scheme used by page_index.
numbering.krisyotam_segments: 0-56, 57 non-empty '%'-separated segments. seg 0-49 == page 0-49; page 50 has no segment (runeless); seg 50-56 == page 51-57.
numbering.lp1: Liber Primus part 1 pages carry scream314 labels ('Runes - 01.jpg', '03.jpg', ...) and are NOT in the 0-57 range. Listed separately under lp1_solved_pages.
numbering.warning: Sources in the wild use at least three numbering schemes for the same pages. See CONFLICTS-B.md C-01/C-02/C-03.

interrupter.note: On solved pages this rune sometimes acts as a skip marker. n_interrupters counts literal occurrences, not confirmed skips.

transcription_conflicts.adjudication: Decrypting the page (atbash + Caesar shift 3) makes reading B give the koan's actual refrain THAT IS NOT WHO YOU ARE / THAT IS WHAT YOU DO NOT WHO YOU ARE. Reading A gives the self-contradictory NOT WHAT YOU ARE. Reading B (EA) is correct; scream314 is in error.
transcription_conflicts.impact: This repository's SOLVED-PAGES.json plaintext for 06.jpg and the words tests/validate.py checks are derived from reading A. LP1 only - the 12,956-rune unsolved LP2 stream is NOT affected.

transcription_conflicts.adjudication: Only page 56 (AN END) is solved and therefore adjudicable: canon's ᛉ (X) decrypts to THERE EXISTS A PAGE, henkman's ᛚ (L) to HERE EXISTS A PAGE. Canon is correct there. The other 8 pages are unsolved and CANNOT be adjudicated without the images.

9 edit blocks. On the solved PARABLE page canon reads ᚣ (Y) giving DIUINITY and the candidate reads ᛖ (E) giving DIUINITE - canon is correct. Four of the nine are lone ᚠ (F) runes at page boundaries, i.e. a separator convention rather than a reading.
